column1: # The routes of the proofs of TOB-QMC (Dai, Han, Molloy, bioRxiv v5, with its supplement), and of the results of other works
# that they cite: which numbered results each proof uses.
# Columns: label, environment, the paper proves it (1/0), results used.
# The paper has no TeX source: the rows are written by hand, from the text of v5 and of its supplement. Every label is assigned
# here, and appears in the docstrings of the Lean results. Unnumbered results proved in running text, and the claims of the
# supplement that the report shows to fail, have rows with labels assigned here.
# Results of the repositories this one requires, restated in TobQmc/External/ and proved from their theorems (proved = 0), with
# the labels of those repositories' routes files, prefixed by their ids (lean4-phylogenetics, docs/CONVENTIONS.md, Sections 2
# and 6). The labels of lean4-tinnik's routes file carry the prefix `tinnik:` already. The consistency claim cites TINNiK's
# Theorem 4; lean4-tinnik proves it, and External.Tinnik states the step of its proof that the claim uses.
# The other sources, written by hand from the sources that were read, each README saying which: Ané et al. 2024; Huber et al. 2025;
# Dinh, Baños 2025; Kane, Tao 2017; ASTRAL-III (Zhang et al. 2018); TREE-QMC (Han, Molloy 2023).
# Mitchell, Allman, Rhodes 2019, behind the T3 option: its Propositions 4.1, 4.2, 5.1 and 5.2, proved in lean4-phylo-network.
